description: Ireland's energy price shock dashboard. Data: CSO CPM23 (EU Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices), cleaned in CleaningData.ipynb and loaded from GitHub. Layout: charts stacked vertically (vconcat). A timeline at the bottom defines a selection called 'brush' that controls which period chart 1 shows. 'config' sets global styles: no border around charts, axis font sizes. 'resolve' gives each chart its own colour scale.

title.subtitle: Drag across the timeline at the bottom to choose a period.

vconcat.description: CHART 1: household electricity price. Filter keeps only the Electricity rows. Line mark in red (#d1495b), the colour used for electricity throughout; clip stops the line drawing outside the chart when zoomed. x = date (temporal), its range is linked to the 'brush' selection so the chart zooms to the period chosen on the timeline; one year label per tick. y = price index (quantitative, 2025 = 100). Tooltip shows month, index (1 decimal place) and % change on a year earlier (with + or - sign).

title.subtitle: Index: 100 = average 2025 price. 50 = half the 2025 price, 125 = 25% more.

vconcat.description: TIMELINE (overview + brush): full 1996-2026 electricity history as a pale red area (40% opacity) so it reads as background context. 'params' defines the 'brush' selection: click and drag left-right (x only) to pick a period; it starts on Jan 2019 to Dec 2024 so the dashboard opens on the crisis. Double-click resets. The x-axis is not linked to the brush, so this strip always shows the whole history, labelled every 5 years with no grid lines.

title.text: Timeline: drag to select a period, double-click to reset
